induction n with d hd
case one =>
  exact le_rfl (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
case rec d hd =>
  have h_ind : d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d := hd
  have h_double : 2 ^ (d + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ d := by simp
  have h_ineq : 2 * (d + 1) ≥ d + 2 :=
    le_add_right (le_mul_right (d + 1) 2) (by norm_num)
  exact le_trans (le_mul_right (d + 1) 2) h_ineq
